My [Lord Bishop](../persons.html#165)
In answer to your appeal I send £5 from myself /10 from a friend\ to Messrs Coutts.[^1] I write because I see you wish to be informed of what is paid in for your intended buildings
I remain respectfully

C M Yonge

[^1]: The Rt.

Rev.

George Francis Popham Blyth (1832–1914), bishop of Jerusalem and the East, had founded the Jerusalem and the East Mission Fund in 1890.

[^2]: On 3 October 1893 a cheque for £5 10s. was recorded as being paid from CMY’s account at Hoare’s to the Jerusalem & East Mission Fund.
